name: Circle of West Binding
summary: The Circle of West Binding is one of several ancient ritual sites scattered across the Arathi Highlands, situated near Thoradin's Wall. Centered around the Stone of West Binding, this arcane ring is overrun by fiery elemental entities bound to the site.

sections.title: The Western Keystone
sections.body: Tucked against the rugged slopes near Thoradin's Wall, the Circle of West Binding forms part of a wider network of ritual sites dispersed throughout the Arathi Highlands. At its heart sits the Stone of West Binding, an ancient relic tied to elemental containment. The grounds are swarming with Burning Exiles—volatile fire elementals that relentlessly guard the perimeter, making any approach to the stone a perilous endeavor for travelers traversing the western plains.

faq.q: What is the Circle of West Binding?
faq.answer: It is an ancient ritual site in western Arathi Highlands, located near Thoradin's Wall. It holds the Stone of West Binding and is fiercely guarded by hostile fire elementals.

faq.q: Why are there fire elementals here?
faq.answer: The Burning Exiles inhabit and guard the Stone of West Binding. They are elemental forces drawn or bound to the ancient magical foci constructed across the Arathi Highlands.
Ruul Onestone is a Boulderfist ogre mage who prowls the site, a rare and dangerous brute rather than a scholar of the binding stone.

angles.text: The binding stones of Arathi offer arcane practitioners insight into how ancient mages and shamans anchored and subdued planar elemental entities.
The volatile presence of the Burning Exiles reveals the lingering elemental unrest tethered to these ancient Arathi keystones.
